mapper.select: SELECT login_id AS loginId, password_hash AS passwordHash, email, student_no AS studentNo, admin_level AS adminLevel FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET is_deleted = 1, name = '탈퇴한 회원', login_id = CONCAT('deleted_', user_id), email = CONCAT('deleted_', user_id, '@removed.local'), phone = NULL, major = 'NONE', student_no = #{studentNoHash}, password_hash = CONCAT('withdrawn:', UUID()), social_id = NULL, last_login_at = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT ban_status AS banStatus, banned_until AS bannedUntil, updated_at AS withdrawnAt FROM users WHERE student_no = #{studentNoHash} AND is_deleted = 1
SELECT setting_value FROM policy_settings WHERE code = #{code}

SELECT u.user_id FROM users u WHERE u.is_deleted = 1 AND u.ban_status = 'none' AND u.updated_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{retentionDays} DAY) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM posts p WHERE p.user_id = u.user_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM comments c WHERE c.user_id = u.user_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM post_likes pl WHERE pl.user_id = u.user_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reports_log r WHERE r.reporter_id = u.user_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM penalty_log pn WHERE pn.user_id = u.user_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM warning_log w WHERE w.user_id = u.user_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ban_log b WHERE b.user_id = u.user_id OR b.lifted_by = u.user_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM moderation_log m WHERE m.acted_by = u.user_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events e WHERE e.user_id = u.user_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM quotes q WHERE q.writer_id = u.user_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM donations d WHERE d.user_id = u.user_id OR d.created_by = u.user_id)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM users WHERE is_deleted = 1 AND user_id IN #{id}
